value: LST 3x3-pixel median around the region coordinate, in kelvin and celsius
70 m product grid, irregular overpass times
Empty lst values mean the source pixel had no retrieval (cloud or quality), not a missing download.
Roughly a third of overpasses yield a usable surface temperature at these points.
Surface temperature is not 2 m air temperature.
qc is the raw QC band value at the centre pixel; it does not flag the cloudy pixels - an empty lst does.
